## Prenuvo - Senior Backend Engineer, Data

🔗 [Apply](https://boards.greenhouse.io/prenuvo/jobs/4738973005)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Backend Engineer building Python services, APIs, and pipelines for Prenuvo’s proactive whole-body healthcare scanning platform. Improving clinical data reliability across products, analytics, reporting, and AI workflows.
Senior Backend Engineer building clinical data infrastructure for Prenuvo’s proactive healthcare scans
- Salary: $165,000 - $180,000 per year
- Tech stack: Cloud, Django, Flask, Python
- Design, build, and operate Python backend services and RESTful APIs for managing clinical data
- Evolve scalable clinical data models using FHIR and HL7 standards
- Establish boundaries, ownership, and contracts across clinical data domains
- Build and maintain batch and event-driven pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver clinical data
- Implement automated validation, testing, reconciliation, and monitoring for data quality and reliability
- Develop transformation layers and curated datasets for clinical reporting, operational analytics, product functionality, and AI use cases
- Implement data documentation, lineage, provenance, versioning, retention, and auditability practices
- Collaborate with clinical, product, application engineering, architecture, data analytics, and AI teams
- 6–8 years of software engineering experience, including ownership of production services and databases
- Strong experience building production Python applications and APIs using FastAPI, Django, or Flask
- Experience designing and operating scalable ingestion, transformation, and delivery pipelines using batch, streaming, or event-driven patterns
- Hands-on experience with clinical or healthcare data
- Strong understanding of FHIR resources, HL7 standards, terminology, and interoperability challenges
- Experience designing normalized, dimensional, and domain-oriented data models
- Ability to independently lead complex initiatives, make sound technical decisions, and balance short-term delivery with long-term maintainability
- Legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa, current or future

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Backend Engineer building Python services, APIs, and pipelines for Prenuvo’s proactive whole-body healthcare scanning platform. Improving clinical data reliability across products, analytics, reporting, and AI workflows.
Senior Backend Engineer building clinical data infrastructure for Prenuvo’s proactive healthcare scans
Role description:
• Design, build, and operate Python backend services and RESTful APIs for managing clinical data
• Evolve scalable clinical data models using FHIR and HL7 standards
• Establish boundaries, ownership, and contracts across clinical data domains
• Build and maintain batch and event-driven pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver clinical data
• Implement automated validation, testing, reconciliation, and monitoring for data quality and reliability
• Develop transformation layers and curated datasets for clinical reporting, operational analytics, product functionality, and AI use cases
• Implement data documentation, lineage, provenance, versioning, retention, and auditability practices
• Collaborate with clinical, product, application engineering, architecture, data analytics, and AI teams
• Lead design discussions, contribute to architectural decisions, review implementations, mentor engineers, and establish engineering standards
Role requirements:
• 6–8 years of software engineering experience, including ownership of production services and databases
• Strong experience building production Python applications and APIs using FastAPI, Django, or Flask
• Experience designing and operating scalable ingestion, transformation, and delivery pipelines using batch, streaming, or event-driven patterns
• Hands-on experience with clinical or healthcare data
• Strong understanding of FHIR resources, HL7 standards, terminology, and interoperability challenges
• Experience designing normalized, dimensional, and domain-oriented data models
• Ability to independently lead complex initiatives, make sound technical decisions, and balance short-term delivery with long-term maintainability
• Legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa, current or future
• Successful candidates must undergo a background check
• Nice to have: experience with FHIR servers, clinical data repositories, electronic health record systems, or medical imaging and reporting workflows
• Nice to have: familiarity with SNOMED CT, LOINC, ICD-10, or DICOM
• Nice to have: experience with cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, and clinical reporting or AI-enabled healthcare products
Benefits:
• Free whole-body scans for each team member
• Growth opportunities and career development
• Weekly team gatherings for connection, sharing, and socializing
• Flexible vacation policy
• 401(k) retirement savings plan with pre-tax contributions; no current company matching contributions
• Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and mental health coverage
• Opportunity to make a positive impact on people's lives and health
Tech stack:
Cloud, Django, Flask, Python
